assumptionPolicy: Treat recorded rules as true author intent until contradicted by nearer project evidence.

rules.instruction: Put mutable state, calculation and game rules in a constructor-injected non-MonoBehaviour Model.
Put Inspector references and Unity API mutations in a MonoBehaviour View.
Connect Model and View in a constructor-injected Presenter; use IStartable and ITickable for VContainer lifecycle.
Register Views with RegisterComponent, status assets with RegisterInstance, Models with Register<T>, and Presenters with RegisterEntryPoint.

patterns.name: status_boundary
patterns.shape: ScriptableObject *StatusInfo implements I*Status; Model depends on interface

patterns.name: runtime_status
patterns.shape: Pure C# *RuntimeInitializeStatus implements the same status interface for runtime relocation/reset

patterns.name: mutable_data_snapshot
patterns.shape: *Data stores mutable Model state; *DataPack exposes a get-only snapshot returned by GetDataPack()

patterns.name: math_boundary
patterns.shape: System.Numerics.Vector2 in calculation layers; UnityEngine.Vector2/Vector3 in Views

patterns.name: reactive_notification
patterns.shape: private readonly Subject<T>, public Observable<T>, CompositeDisposable ownership

rules: Accept CancellationToken on public asynchronous boundaries.
Link caller token with GetCancellationTokenOnDestroy in MonoBehaviour Views.
Treat expected OperationCanceledException as normal completion with a cancellation filter.
Restore temporary runtime state in finally.
Kill and link DOTween tweens to their GameObject lifetime.

comments.lineCommentStyle: Short action or calculation-stage phrase immediately before the relevant statement.
comments.xmlSummaryUse: Public contracts, lifecycle ownership, non-obvious state changes and compatibility behavior.
avoid: comments that merely restate assignment syntax

testing.testDoubles: private sealed nested Stub implementing the production interface

doNotIntroduce: a second architecture beside existing MVP
new global singleton or Manager without an existing local precedent
Coroutine where nearby code uses UniTask
C# events where nearby code uses R3
bulk rename of serialized fields, PlayerPrefs keys, enum members or compatibility typos
new namespace in Assets/!lumirr/scripts without a project-wide decision
